create_PairViewer_optimizer: create a PairViewer dummy optimizer instance to visualize results for a symmetrized pair of images
get_depthmaps_PairViewer: get the depth maps for both images in the PairViewer optimizer as a list of tensors
get_intrinsics_PairViewer: get the 3x3 camera intrinsic matrices for each image from the PairViewer optimizer
get_im_poses_PairViewer: get the camera pose matrices for each image from the PairViewer optimizer
depth_to_pts3d_PairViewer: convert depth maps to 3D point clouds using intrinsics and camera poses in PairViewer
